note: p = official forecast (AGG_RT): mean of three blind lenses after red-team adjustment. Probabilities 0.01-0.99.

forecasts.question: Will the president of Russia sign by 31.12.2026 a decree announcing mobilisation (general or partial)?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 a decree of the president of the Russian Federation announcing mobilisation (the term "mobilisation" in the title or operative part) under the law on mobilisation preparation and mobilisation is published on publication.pravo.gov.ru or kremlin.ru. Decrees on conscription (including no. 998 of 29.12.2025), on exercises and special reserve formations, or on contract service do not count.

forecasts.question: Will at least one person be killed on the territory of a NATO state by a Russian drone or missile strike by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the government of a NATO state confirms that after 23.09.2026 at least one person was killed on its territory (land, territorial waters, airspace) by a drone or missile launched by Russia, including one that strayed or was shot down over that territory. Attribution to Russia — in the government statement.

forecasts.question: Will the Pentagon or the White House announce by 31.03.2027 a decision to reduce the number of US troops in Europe by at least 10,000?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if an official statement (defense.gov, whitehouse.gov, eucom.mil) published after 23.09.2026 announces a decision (not an option or a leak) to reduce US troop strength in Europe by at least 10,000 soldiers net, in total across one or more announcements after 23.09.2026. Moves within Europe do not reduce strength. Reductions announced before 23.09.2026 do not count.

forecasts.question: Will the PRC Eastern Theater Command announce named military exercises around Taiwan by 31.03.2027?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 the PLA Eastern Theater Command or the PRC Ministry of National Defense announces exercises with a proper name covering the area around Taiwan. Unnamed combat-readiness patrols do not count.
forecasts.resolution_source: eng.chinamil.com.cn; mod.gov.cn; Xinhua; Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense

forecasts.question: Will the settlement price of the ICE Brent front-month contract exceed 120 USD/bbl on any trading day between 24.09 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if on any trading day in this period the settlement (closing) price of nearest-month ICE Brent > 120.00 USD/bbl. Sources: ICE or Reuters, CNBC, Trading Economics; in case of discrepancy ICE decides.

forecasts.question: Will the settlement price of the ICE Brent front-month contract fall below 80 USD/bbl on any trading day between 24.09 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if on any trading day in this period the settlement (closing) price of nearest-month ICE Brent < 80.00 USD/bbl. Sources: ICE or Reuters, CNBC, Trading Economics; in case of discrepancy ICE decides.

forecasts.question: Will EU gas storage fill per GIE AGSI+ on gas day 01.01.2027 be below 55.0%?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the EU storage fill value (EU, % of capacity) in AGSI+ for gas day 01.01.2027 < 55.0. The first publication for that day counts.

forecasts.question: Will the US president impose a tariff under H.R. 5334 on goods from at least one country other than Russia by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 a proclamation, executive order or Federal Register notice is published imposing a tariff on goods from a country other than Russia with reference to H.R. 5334 (Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026), with an effective date no later than 31.12.2026. An announcement without an act does not count.

forecasts.question: Will the USA introduce a tariff on EU goods exceeding the 15% ceiling set in the 2026 agreement by 31.03.2027?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 the US government publishes an act (proclamation, executive order, USTR notice in the Federal Register) raising the combined tariff rate above 15% on EU goods covered by the "all-inclusive" ceiling, with an effective date no later than 31.03.2027. Not counted: section 232 tariffs on steel and aluminium, categories excluded from the ceiling as of 23.09.2026, and anti-dumping and countervailing duties.

forecasts.question: Will the Monetary Policy Council change the NBP reference rate at any meeting between 24.09 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the MPC statement after a meeting in this period changes the reference rate (in either direction).

forecasts.question: Will the ECB raise the deposit rate at a meeting held between 24.09 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after a meeting of the ECB Governing Council in this period (29.10 or XII) the deposit rate is higher than 2.50%.

forecasts.question: Will OFAC add to the SDN list by 31.03.2027 a bank registered in mainland PRC in connection with Iran or Russia?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if an OFAC notice (Recent Actions) after 23.09.2026 adds to the SDN list a bank (an institution with a banking licence) registered in the PRC outside Hong Kong and Macao, with a justification relating to Iran or Russia. Branches of foreign banks in the PRC and non-bank institutions do not count.

forecasts.question: Will the EU Council adopt the 22nd package of sanctions against Russia by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 the EU Council announces the formal adoption of a package of sanctions against Russia named in the Council statement as the 22nd package.

forecasts.question: Will the PRC announce by 27.11.2026 an extension or repeal of the suspension of the ban on exports of gallium, germanium, antimony and superhard materials to the USA?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 and no later than 27.11.2026 MOFCOM announces an extension of the suspension of this ban for any period or its permanent repeal.

forecasts.question: Will MOFCOM add at least one US entity to the export control list or the unreliable entity list between 24.09 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if a MOFCOM announcement published in this period contains a new listing of a US entity on the export control list (出口管制管控名单) or the unreliable entity list.

forecasts.question: Will the US government permit exports to the PRC of Nvidia AI chips with the Blackwell architecture or newer by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 the Department of Commerce (BIS) or the White House announces permission (a rule, licences or a licensing policy) for exports to the PRC of at least one Nvidia chip with the Blackwell architecture or newer (including a reduced-performance version), or Nvidia officially confirms receiving such permission.

forecasts.question: Will any NATO state submit a request for consultations under Article 4 of the North Atlantic Treaty between 24.09 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if NATO or the government of a member state confirms that a request for consultations under Article 4 was submitted in this period.

forecasts.question: Will the USA and Iran announce by 31.12.2026 the conclusion of an agreement (framework, interim or final) that includes the opening of the Strait of Hormuz?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 official sources of both governments (White House or State Department, and the president or Foreign Ministry of Iran) confirm the conclusion of an agreement, including a memorandum or interim agreement, whose announced content includes opening or restoring shipping through Hormuz. Declarations of readiness and frameworks for further talks without an agreed text do not count.

forecasts.question: Will Donald Trump personally attend the APEC leaders' meeting in Shenzhen (18–19.11.2026)?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if Trump is physically present at the APEC leaders' meeting in Shenzhen, as confirmed by the White House or at least two news agencies. Remote participation or a delegation without the president — NO. If the leaders' meeting does not take place by 30.11.2026 — NO.

forecasts.question: Will Vladimir Putin and Donald Trump meet in person by 31.03.2027?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 Putin and Trump meet in person, as confirmed by the Kremlin and the White House.

forecasts.question: Will a new video or audio recording of Mojtaba Khamenei speaking be published by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 official Iranian media (IRIB, khamenei.ir, leader.ir) publish a video or audio recording of him speaking or appearing in public, and at least two independent international media consider it new and authentic. Written statements, photos and archive recordings do not count.

forecasts.question: Will the CNE or the government of Venezuela announce a specific date for the presidential election by 31.03.2027?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 the CNE or the government of Venezuela publishes a schedule with a specific voting day for the presidential election.

forecasts.question: Will Assimi Goïta cease to hold power in Mali by 31.03.2027 (coup, resignation, death or capture of Bamako by JNIM or the FLA)?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if at least two independent international media confirm that after 23.09.2026 Goïta ceased to serve as transitional president or lost de facto control over Bamako.
forecasts.resolution_source: news agencies (AFP, Reuters, AP); Al Jazeera; ACLED

forecasts.question: Will the 7-day average number of transits through the Strait of Hormuz per IMF PortWatch exceed 40 ships per day on any day between 24.09 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if IMF PortWatch data (transit calls, Strait of Hormuz) show a 7-day average above 40 for any day in this period.

forecasts.question: Will the USA officially lift or suspend the naval blockade of Iranian ports by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 the White House, the Pentagon or CENTCOM announces the lifting or suspension (including temporary) of the blockade of Iranian ports as a whole.

forecasts.question: Will the government or prosecutor of a Baltic Sea state announce by 31.03.2027 damage to a subsea cable or pipeline in the Baltic together with proceedings concerning external action?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 the government or prosecutor of PL, DE, DK, SE, FI, EE, LV or LT announces damage to a subsea cable (power or telecommunications) or pipeline in the Baltic Sea and the opening of an investigation or the detention of a ship on suspicion of external action (sabotage, dragged anchor). Technical failures without such proceedings do not count.
forecasts.resolution_source: statements of governments and prosecutors of Baltic Sea states; Reuters

forecasts.question: Will US forces carry out a strike on Houthi targets in Yemen by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 CENTCOM, the Pentagon or the White House confirms a US strike on Houthi targets in Yemen.

forecasts.question: Will the DSCA notify Congress by 31.12.2026 of arms sales to Taiwan with a combined value of at least 1 bn USD?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the sum of DSCA notifications for TECRO published after 23.09.2026 is at least 1 bn USD.

forecasts.question: Will Fitch or S&P downgrade Poland's long-term foreign-currency rating by 31.03.2027?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 Fitch or S&P downgrades Poland's long-term foreign-currency rating below A−.

forecasts.question: Will the EU Council adopt by 30.06.2027 a legal act allowing the frozen assets of the Bank of Russia themselves (not only windfall profits) to be used for Ukraine?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 the EU Council adopts a regulation or decision (published in EUR-Lex) allowing the frozen assets of the Bank of Russia or their equivalent to be used for Ukraine, including through a loan secured by those assets. Political conclusions of the European Council do not count.

forecasts.question: Will Armenia and Azerbaijan sign a peace treaty by 30.06.2027?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 the leaders or foreign ministers of both states sign the text of a peace treaty (initialling does not count), as confirmed by both governments.

forecasts.question: Will ISW assess by 30.06.2027 that Russian forces have taken control of the whole of Kramatorsk or the whole of Sloviansk?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after 23.09.2026 an ISW report states Russian control over the whole of Kramatorsk or the whole of Sloviansk.

forecasts.question: Will the governments of the USA and the PRC both announce by 10.01.2027 an extension of the trade truce beyond 10.01.2027 or a new trade agreement replacing it?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if between 08.10.2026 and 10.01.2027 both governments officially announce that the suspension of the measures of the Kuala Lumpur (Busan) arrangement is extended to a date after 10.01.2027, or announce a new trade agreement replacing it. US: White House, USTR, Treasury, Commerce or a Federal Register notice; PRC: MOFCOM, State Council Tariff Commission or MFA. Leaders' on-record statements count; statements of one side only do not.

forecasts.question: Will Abbas Araghchi cease to be Iran's foreign minister by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if between 08.10 and 31.12.2026 Araghchi is dismissed, impeached by the Majlis, resigns (resignation accepted) or a successor is appointed, as announced by the presidency, the Majlis or IRNA. An acting replacement during an absence does not count.

forecasts.question: Will the Polish Operational Command (DO RSZ) or the Ministry of National Defence confirm a violation of Polish airspace by an aircraft, helicopter, drone or missile from Russia or Belarus between 08.10 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if DO RSZ or the Polish MoD officially confirms that an aircraft, helicopter, drone or missile coming from the territory or airspace of Russia or Belarus violated Polish airspace on a date from 08.10 to 31.12.2026. Balloons carrying contraband do not count.

forecasts.question: Will Vladimir Putin personally attend the APEC leaders' meeting in Shenzhen (18-19.11.2026)?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if Putin is physically present in Shenzhen at the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting on 18 or 19.11.2026 (kremlin.ru or the host's official record). Video participation = NO. If the meeting is moved, the leaders' meeting held by 30.11.2026 counts; if it is held only online, NO.

forecasts.question: Will the Cameco month-end U3O8 spot price exceed 95.00 USD/lb for October, November or December 2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the month-end spot price published by Cameco (UxC/TradeTech average) for the end of October, November or December 2026 is above 95.00 USD/lb.

forecasts.question: Will the EU Council adopt by 30.11.2026 a Russia sanctions act containing at least one new import or export prohibition?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if between 08.10 and 30.11.2026 the Council adopts a decision or regulation under the Russia sanctions regime that introduces at least one new prohibition on imports from or exports to Russia (including adding goods to existing prohibition lists). Listings of persons, entities or vessels alone do not count.

forecasts.question: Will the US government impose a ban or mandatory quota on exports of diesel or other distillates by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if an executive order, proclamation or Federal Register rule restricting exports of distillate fuels (ban, licence requirement or quota) is in force on any day from 08.10 to 31.12.2026. Voluntary industry commitments do not count.

forecasts.question: Will the European Commission send Poland a letter of formal notice concerning the reduced VAT rate on motor fuels by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if a Commission infringement decision (letter of formal notice or later stage) adopted between 08.10 and 31.12.2026 names Poland in relation to the reduced VAT rate on motor fuels under the VAT Directive (Commission infringement package or database).

forecasts.question: Will both the USA and the PRC put into effect reduced tariffs on goods from the Board of Trade 30-for-30 lists by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if by 31.12.2026 a US act (Federal Register or HTS notice) and a PRC act (State Council Tariff Commission or MOFCOM announcement) each make reduced tariff rates effective for goods from the lists published on 27-28.09.2026, with an effective date on or before 31.12.2026.

forecasts.question: Will a National Defense Authorization Act for FY2027 containing a numerical floor on US forces in the EUCOM area be enacted by 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the FY2027 NDAA is signed into law between 08.10 and 31.12.2026 and its enacted text contains a provision restricting a reduction of US forces in the EUCOM area of responsibility below a stated number of personnel (in any form, including a certification requirement).

forecasts.question: Will Russia and Ukraine both confirm by 30.06.2027 a signed agreement on a ceasefire covering the whole front line?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if between 08.10.2026 and 30.06.2027 both the Russian and the Ukrainian government officially confirm the signing or entry into force of a ceasefire (truce, armistice or peace agreement) covering the entire line of contact. Sectoral ceasefires (energy, Black Sea, grain) do not count.

forecasts.question: Will the US-Denmark-Greenland defence agreement of 22.09.2026 enter into force by 30.06.2027?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if by 30.06.2027 the government of Denmark, Greenland or the USA officially announces that the agreement has entered into force (e.g. the diplomatic note confirming completion of parliamentary procedures).

forecasts.question: Will the Federal Reserve suspend, restrict or attach new conditions to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority's access to the FIMA repo facility by 31.03.2027?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the Federal Reserve Board or the Federal Reserve Bank of New York publishes between 08.10.2026 and 31.03.2027 a decision suspending, restricting or attaching new conditions to the HKMA's access to the FIMA repo facility. A reply letter without a change does not count.

forecasts.question: Will ISW assess by 31.03.2027 that Russian forces have taken control of the whole of Kostiantynivka (Donetsk oblast)?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if an ISW Russian Offensive Campaign Assessment published between 08.10.2026 and 31.03.2027 assesses that Russian forces control the whole of Kostiantynivka (or that the town has been captured). Russian MoD claims alone do not count.

forecasts.question: Will the US or Polish government officially announce by 31.03.2027 the location of a new permanent US Army base in Poland?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if between 08.10.2026 and 31.03.2027 the White House, the Pentagon, the Polish government or the President of Poland officially names the town or site of a new permanent US Army base in Poland. Lists of candidate locations do not count.

forecasts.question: Will the settlement price of the ICE Brent front-month contract fall below 70.00 USD/bbl on any trading day between 08.10.2026 and 30.06.2027?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the ICE Brent front-month settlement is below 70.00 USD/bbl on any trading day from 08.10.2026 to 30.06.2027 (sources as in Q-0074).
forecasts.resolution_source: ICE Futures Europe; Bloomberg/Reuters wire; Investing.com

forecasts.question: Will the Russian Ministry of Defence report at least 1,400 Ukrainian drones intercepted or destroyed in a single daily or overnight report between 18.11 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if any single report of the Russian MoD (one overnight report or one daily summary, not a sum of reports) published between 18.11.2026 and 31.12.2026 states that at least 1,400 Ukrainian fixed-wing drones (UAVs) were intercepted or destroyed. Uncrewed surface or underwater vessels are not counted. The question concerns the MoD statement (a fact about a statement), not the true number.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: Russian MoD Telegram channel t.me/s/mod_russia (harvested feed tg_mod_russia). Fallback: Interfax or The Moscow Times quoting the MoD report.

forecasts.question: Will the Dutch TTF front-month gas futures close above 100.00 EUR/MWh on any trading day between 18.11 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the daily close (Price column) of the front-month Dutch TTF natural gas futures in the Investing.com historical data table is above 100.00 EUR/MWh for any trading day from 18.11.2026 to 31.12.2026. If the table is unreadable at resolution: the ICE Endex front-month settlement reported by Reuters or Bloomberg (via any outlet), then Trading Economics.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: investing.com/commodities/dutch-ttf-gas-c1-futures-historical-data. Fallback: ICE Endex settlement via Reuters/Bloomberg; Trading Economics.

forecasts.question: Will the Bank of Russia cut its key rate at the board meeting of 18.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if after the Bank of Russia board meeting scheduled for 18.12.2026 (or a rescheduled one held by 31.12.2026) the key rate is lower than 14.00%. NO if it is held or raised.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: cbr.ru (key rate press release; key-rate table, harvested). Fallback: Interfax.

forecasts.question: Will MOFCOM or the GAC announce, between 18.11.2026 and 10.01.2027, a further continuation of the suspension of the October-2025 rare-earth export-control announcements beyond 10.01.2027, or their repeal?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if between 18.11.2026 and 10.01.2027 MOFCOM or GAC publishes an announcement that continues the suspension of the measures of MOFCOM/GAC announcements of 2025 Nos. 55-58 and MOFCOM Nos. 61-62 (as continued by Announcement No. 58 of 2026) to any date after 10.01.2027, or repeals them. Continuing only some of them counts if it covers the rare-earth controls. A statement without an announcement text does not count.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: mofcom.gov.cn (announcements). Fallback: Xinhua (english.news.cn) quoting MOFCOM.

forecasts.question: Will MOFCOM publish, between 18.11 and 31.12.2026, an announcement imposing export controls on additional rare-earth or other critical-mineral items, or reinstating a suspended control?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if between 18.11.2026 and 31.12.2026 MOFCOM (alone or with GAC) publishes an announcement that (a) adds goods or technologies related to rare earths, rare-earth magnets, gallium, germanium, antimony, graphite, tungsten, indium, bismuth, tellurium, molybdenum or lithium-battery materials to China's export controls, or (b) ends early a suspension of such controls. The lapse of a suspension on its stated end date without an announcement does not count; additions of foreign entities to control lists do not count (see Q-0023).
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: mofcom.gov.cn (announcements). Fallback: Xinhua quoting MOFCOM.

forecasts.question: Will another meeting of government delegations of the USA, Ukraine and Russia take place between 18.11 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if a meeting of government delegations of all three states in one place, at any level, takes place between 18.11.2026 and 31.12.2026 and at least two of the three parties confirm it officially. Separate bilateral meetings, including shuttle formats in one city, do not count. A meeting with additional parties (e.g. European representatives) counts.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: Ukrinform (ukrinform.net) reporting the Office of the President of Ukraine, and the Kremlin feed (harvested). Fallback: whitehouse.gov; Interfax.

forecasts.question: Will Pete Hegseth cease to hold the office of US Secretary of Defense (Secretary of War) between 18.11.2026 and 31.03.2027?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if between 18.11.2026 and 31.03.2027 Pete Hegseth ceases to hold the office (resignation taking effect, dismissal, removal after impeachment, death or incapacity). An announced resignation counts only once it takes effect within the window. An acting arrangement after his departure counts as YES.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: whitehouse.gov (briefing room). Fallback: NBC News; CNN.

forecasts.question: Will Serbia's National Assembly elect a new Prime Minister and government between 18.11 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if between 18.11.2026 and 31.12.2026 the National Assembly of Serbia votes to elect a Prime Minister and the government (investiture vote). A nomination or mandate without the Assembly vote does not count.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: srbija.gov.rs (Government of Serbia news). Fallback: RFE/RL (rferl.org); Balkan Insight.

forecasts.question: Will IMF PortWatch record at least 10 transits through the Strait of Hormuz on any single day between 18.11 and 30.11.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the daily total number of transits (n_total) for the Strait of Hormuz in the IMF PortWatch daily chokepoint series is at least 10 for any date from 18.11.2026 to 30.11.2026, as read at resolution. AIS-based counts only; escort figures from JMIC or CENTCOM do not count.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: IMF PortWatch daily chokepoint data (ArcGIS API Daily_Chokepoints_Data; harvested dataset portwatch). Fallback: the PortWatch Strait of Hormuz chokepoint page (same series). If no row for the window is readable by stage 01 of the edition after next, the question waits as Q-0037 did.

forecasts.question: Will the Panama Canal Authority put into force more than 34 daily transit booking slots on any day between 18.11 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if an ACP advisory to shipping or ACP announcement sets total daily transit booking slots above 34 and that limit is in force on any day from 18.11.2026 to 31.12.2026.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: pancanal.com (advisories and press releases). Fallback: gCaptain; DataPortuaria.

forecasts.question: Will the EIA Europe Brent spot price (FRED DCOILBRENTEU) for 30.11.2026 be above 90.00 USD/bbl?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the FRED series DCOILBRENTEU value for 30.11.2026 is above 90.00 USD/bbl. If there is no value for 30.11.2026, the nearest earlier date with a value counts. The value as first available on FRED decides.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: fred.stlouisfed.org/series/DCOILBRENTEU (harvested fred_brent). Fallback: EIA spot price page RBRTED (eia.gov).

forecasts.question: Will the Statistics Poland (GUS) flash estimate of CPI inflation for November 2026 be higher than 3.5% y/y?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the first publication of the GUS flash estimate of CPI for November 2026 (expected 30.11.2026) is above 3.5% y/y. NO if 3.5% or lower. Later revisions and the final index do not count; if the flash is published after 30.11, the first flash publication still decides.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: stat.gov.pl (flash estimate). Fallback: PAP Biznes or ISBnews quoting GUS.

forecasts.question: Will the FAO Food Price Index (FFPI) for November 2026 be lower than 133.9 points?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the first publication of the FFPI for November 2026 (expected 04.12.2026) is below 133.9 points (the October value as first published on 06.11.2026). Revisions of October do not change the threshold.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: fao.org/worldfoodsituation/foodpricesindex. Fallback: FAO newsroom; Reuters quoting FAO.

forecasts.question: Will CENTCOM or the government of a Gulf Cooperation Council state confirm an Iranian drone or missile attack on a US military installation on that state's territory between 18.11 and 30.11.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if between 18.11.2026 and 30.11.2026 CENTCOM (or another US government body) or the government of Bahrain, Qatar, the UAE, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia or Oman confirms that Iran (including the IRGC) launched at least one drone or missile at a US military installation on GCC territory during that period, whether or not it was intercepted. Iranian claims alone do not count.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: The National (thenationalnews.com) reporting the official confirmation. Fallback: CNN; Al Jazeera.

forecasts.question: Will Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense publish at least two press releases on a PLA Joint Combat Readiness Patrol dated between 18.11 and 30.11.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the English press-release list of Taiwan's MND contains at least two releases dated 18.11.2026-30.11.2026 whose title or text reports a PLA joint combat readiness patrol. Daily aircraft reports without such a release do not count.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: mnd.gov.tw/en/news/PressReleaseList. Fallback: Focus Taiwan (CNA); Taipei Times.

forecasts.question: Will the NBP average EUR/PLN exchange rate (table A) for 30.11.2026 be above 4.4000?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the EUR/PLN mid rate in the NBP table A published for 30.11.2026 is above 4.4000. If no table is published that day, the last earlier table counts.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: api.nbp.pl (table A; harvested). Fallback: nbp.pl table A archive.

forecasts.question: Will a joint statement of the leaders of the USA, China and Russia be published between 18.11 and 22.11.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if between 18.11.2026 and 22.11.2026 the White House, the PRC Foreign Ministry or the Kremlin publishes a text presented as a joint statement or joint declaration of the three leaders (Trump, Xi, Putin). Bilateral statements, a chair's statement, or separate national readouts do not count.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: whitehouse.gov briefing room. Fallback: kremlin.ru (harvested feed); fmprc.gov.cn.

forecasts.question: Will the Partido Popular win strictly more seats than any other party in Spain's Congress of Deputies in the general election of 29.11.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the provisional results of the Ministry of the Interior (scrutiny 100%) give the PP more seats in the Congress of Deputies than any other party; a tie for first place is NO. If the election is postponed beyond 30.11.2026: NO.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: Ministry of the Interior provisional results, linked from lamoncloa.gob.es (Elecciones Generales 29N). Fallback: RTVE (rtve.es); Reuters.

forecasts.question: Will the Estonian government adopt, between 18.11 and 30.11.2026, a decision to close its road border crossing points with Russia to passenger traffic?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if between 18.11.2026 and 30.11.2026 the Government of Estonia adopts a decision (order or regulation) closing at least one of the road border crossing points Narva, Koidula or Luhamaa to passenger traffic, for any period starting on any date. Announcements of intent do not count.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: valitsus.ee (Government news). Fallback: ERR News (news.err.ee).

forecasts.question: Will Donald Trump and Kim Jong Un meet in person between 18.11 and 30.11.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the White House confirms, or Yonhap and one other international news agency report, that Trump and Kim met in person between 18.11.2026 and 30.11.2026.

forecasts.question: Will the Verkhovna Rada adopt the 2027 State Budget law in final reading between 18.11 and 30.11.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if between 18.11.2026 and 30.11.2026 the Verkhovna Rada adopts the law on the State Budget of Ukraine for 2027 (bill 16000 or its successor) as a whole in the final reading. Signature by the President is not required.

forecasts.question: Will Russia and Ukraine carry out a single prisoner exchange in which each side releases at least 500 persons between 18.11 and 30.11.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if between 18.11.2026 and 30.11.2026 one exchange takes place in which each side releases at least 500 persons (prisoners of war and civilians), as reported by Ukraine's Coordination Headquarters for the Treatment of Prisoners of War or the President of Ukraine, and confirmed by the Russian MoD or the Kremlin. Exchanges in stages over several days count as one if both sides present them as one exchange.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: Ukrinform (ukrinform.net) reporting the Coordination Headquarters or the President. Fallback: Interfax (Russian MoD confirmation); Kyiv Independent.

forecasts.question: Will OFAC add at least one person or entity to the SDN list under a Russia-related programme between 18.11 and 30.11.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if an OFAC action dated 18.11.2026-30.11.2026 adds at least one SDN entry tagged RUSSIA-EO14024 (or another Russia-related programme tag). General licences, delistings and identifier updates do not count.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: ofac.treasury.gov/recent-actions. Fallback: the harvested SDN list diff.

forecasts.question: Will Romanian authorities report a merchant vessel hit by a drone, uncrewed surface vessel or missile in Romania's territorial sea or exclusive economic zone between 18.11 and 30.11.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if between 18.11.2026 and 30.11.2026 the Romanian Ministry of National Defence, the Naval Forces, the Government or the President states that a merchant vessel was hit by a drone, uncrewed surface vessel or missile in Romania's territorial sea or EEZ during that period. Attribution to any state is not required; mines and unexplained fires do not count.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: mapn.ro (MApN releases). Fallback: Euronews; gov.ro.

forecasts.question: Will the US government confirm on the record a US strike on Iranian land territory (including islands) carried out between 18.11 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the President (remarks or posts count), the White House, the Department of Defense/War or CENTCOM confirms on the record a US strike on Iranian land territory, including Iranian islands and coastal sites, carried out between 18.11.2026 and 31.12.2026. Strikes on ships at sea do not count; anonymous US officials alone do not count.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: whitehouse.gov, or the President's remarks as reported by NBC News. Fallback: CNN.

forecasts.question: Will representatives of the US and Iranian governments meet in person in the same room between 18.11 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if between 18.11.2026 and 31.12.2026 representatives of the US and Iranian governments meet in person in the same room (directly, or with a mediator present in the room), and the US or Iranian government confirms it. Separate meetings of a mediator with each side, including in the same city, do not count.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: whitehouse.gov or US/Iranian government statements as reported by NBC News. Fallback: The National; Al Jazeera.

forecasts.question: Will the FOMC raise the federal funds target range at its meeting of 08-09.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the FOMC statement of 09.12.2026 sets the upper bound of the target range above 4.00%. If the statement is unreadable: FRED DFEDTARU above 4.00 on 10.12.2026.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: FRED DFEDTARU (harvested). Fallback: federalreserve.gov (FOMC statement).

forecasts.question: Will a lapse in US federal appropriations (a government shutdown) begin on any day between 12.12 and 31.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if on any day from 12.12.2026 to 31.12.2026 appropriations for agencies funded by the continuing resolution lapse and OPM or OMB directs shutdown (furlough) procedures. A lapse that ends before agencies open for business on the next working day still counts if OPM or OMB announced shutdown procedures.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: opm.gov (operating status and shutdown furlough guidance). Fallback: NBC News; CRS.

forecasts.question: Will the White House or the Pentagon announce, between 18.11 and 31.12.2026, a decision to reduce US troops stationed in Europe by at least 5,000?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if between 18.11.2026 and 31.12.2026 the White House or the Department of Defense/War officially announces a decision (one decision or a package announced together) reducing the number of US troops stationed in Europe by at least 5,000. Media reports of options or recommendations do not count; rotations ending without replacement count only if announced as a reduction.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: whitehouse.gov. Fallback: Defense News (defensenews.com) reporting the Pentagon announcement.

forecasts.question: Will Eurostat's flash estimate of euro-area annual HICP inflation for November 2026 be 4.0% or higher?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the first Eurostat flash estimate of euro-area annual HICP inflation for November 2026 (expected 01-02.12.2026) is 4.0% or higher. Later revisions do not count.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: ec.europa.eu/eurostat (euro indicators). Fallback: ECB Statistical Data Warehouse; Reuters quoting Eurostat.

forecasts.question: Will the Knesset approve a new Israeli government in a confidence vote between 18.11 and 20.12.2026?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if between 18.11.2026 and 20.12.2026 the Knesset approves a new government in a vote of confidence (investiture), whoever leads it.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: Times of Israel (timesofisrael.com). Fallback: Knesset press releases (knesset.gov.il); Reuters.

forecasts.question: Will BIS publish in the Federal Register, between 18.11.2026 and 10.01.2027, a document extending the suspension of the Affiliates (50%) rule beyond 10.01.2027 or rescinding the rule?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if a Federal Register document of the Bureau of Industry and Security published between 18.11.2026 and 10.01.2027 extends the suspension of the end-user controls for affiliates of listed entities to any date after 10.01.2027, or rescinds the rule.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: federalregister.gov (API). Fallback: bis.gov press releases.

forecasts.question: Will Poland's Minister of Energy publish, by 31.01.2027, a maximum retail fuel price notice applying to any day in January 2027?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if by 31.01.2027 the Minister of Energy publishes a notice setting maximum retail prices of motor fuels (the CPN mechanism or its successor) that applies to any day from 01.01.2027 to 31.01.2027.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: gov.pl/web/energia (news). Fallback: Monitor Polski; Bankier/PAP.

forecasts.question: Will a representative of an E5 government (France, Germany, Italy, Poland, UK) or of the EU institutions take part in a negotiating round together with US, Ukrainian and Russian government delegations between 18.11.2026 and 31.03.2027?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if between 18.11.2026 and 31.03.2027 a meeting takes place in which government delegations of the USA, Ukraine and Russia and a representative of at least one E5 government or of the EU institutions sit together, and the Kremlin and at least one other participant confirm it.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: Ukrinform (ukrinform.net). Fallback: Kremlin feed (harvested); Interfax.

forecasts.question: Will the Cameco month-end long-term uranium price be 100.00 USD/lb or higher for any month-end from November 2026 to March 2027?
forecasts.resolution_criterion: YES if the long-term U3O8 price published by Cameco for any month-end from 30.11.2026 to 31.03.2027 is 100.00 USD/lb or higher.
forecasts.resolution_source: Deciding: cameco.com/invest/markets/uranium-price. Fallback: TradeTech or UxC long-term indicator as reported by World Nuclear News.
